name: flagship
vibe: The benchmark — a DARK cinematic product-showcase launch film in the Apple keynote / Linear / Vercel / Raycast dark register. A deep near-black indigo stage with a glowing accent nebula, big BRIGHT dashboard panels holding real product screenshots that pop against the dark (screenshots are the hero, ~40-60% of frame) with an accent-glow halo lift, plus purposeful glowing data-graphics (traveling gradient data-waves + a rising growth graph-line) and high-contrast white typography with a bright gradient emphasis. Rendered as a native Three.js scene with a cinematic camera that dollies, focus-pulls, orbits and pulls back. The deliberate DARK counterpoint to the bright brightlife pack.
